tasks.title: Fix Checksum Validator Message Key
tasks.description: Update the direct custom checksum validator test so its mocked default constraint message template matches the real annotation message key. Keep this as a narrow test-evidence cleanup for StadiumChecksumValidatorTests: the custom validator behavior should not change, and the test should continue to prove valid checksum, invalid checksum, null input, and null relevant field behavior.
acceptance_criteria: StadiumChecksumValidatorTests uses {validator.stadiumChecksum} as the mocked default constraint message template
The stale {competition.checksum.valid} message key is no longer used as the checksum validator default message template in the test
Existing checksum validator behavior tests still pass
No production validator or annotation behavior is changed
The test remains direct coverage for the required custom annotation and custom validator validation category

tasks.title: Add Competition Validator Edge-Case Tests
tasks.description: Extend CompetitionValidatorTests with missing Spring validator class coverage. Keep the tests at the validator layer using BeanPropertyBindingResult, mocked repositories, and existing DTO fixtures where practical. Cover the match date upper bound, null input safety, repository skip behavior for incomplete stadium/time data, update-aware conflict lookup, and a valid no-error case.
acceptance_criteria: A date after 6 June 2026 rejects field date through CompetitionValidatorTests
A null date does not throw and leaves required-field validation to DTO annotations
Null stadium, date, or time skips the stadium/time conflict repository lookup
An existing-match DTO with an id uses the update-aware conflict repository lookup instead of the create lookup
A valid competition input produces no custom validator field errors
Tests use BeanPropertyBindingResult for Spring Validator coverage
Tests assert field-level behavior and repository interactions only where those interactions prove validator responsibility

tasks.title: Add Competition DTO Numeric Annotation Tests
tasks.description: Add missing InputCompetitionDTOValidationTests for annotation-owned numeric constraints. Use a Jakarta Validator, not Spring Validator or repository mocks, so these tests remain clean evidence for existing annotation validation on the competition request DTO.
acceptance_criteria: Negative stadiumCode rejects through Jakarta annotation validation
Negative checksum rejects through Jakarta annotation validation
Existing class-level stadium checksum validation remains covered through normal Jakarta validation
Tests make the failing field or violation path clear enough to defend
No Spring Validator or repository mocking is introduced in InputCompetitionDTOValidationTests

tasks.title: Expand Registration DTO Validation Tests
tasks.description: Make registration DTO annotation coverage more explicit for required login data. Add or clarify focused InputRegistrationDTOValidationTests for blank password, blank email, invalid email, and valid registration behavior while keeping the tests at the DTO-level Jakarta validation layer.
acceptance_criteria: Blank password is rejected as a clear registration DTO validation case
Blank email is rejected as a clear registration DTO validation case
Invalid email is rejected if this is not already clearly covered
Existing valid registration DTO coverage remains
Tests use Jakarta Validator for existing annotation validation coverage
Tests do not hardcode user-facing validation message text

tasks.title: Expand Team And Invite DTO Validation Tests
tasks.description: Add missing null and whitespace-only DTO validation cases for team creation and team joining. Keep the tests as Jakarta Validator annotation coverage, and use parameterized tests only if they keep the expected failing field obvious and the test shorter.
acceptance_criteria: InputTeamDTOValidationTests rejects null team name
InputTeamDTOValidationTests rejects whitespace-only team name
InputTeamJoinDTOValidationTests rejects null invite code
InputTeamJoinDTOValidationTests rejects whitespace-only invite code
Existing valid DTO cases remain
Parameterized tests are used only if they improve readability and keep the expected failing field obvious

tasks.title: Verify Validation Test Suite
tasks.description: Run the narrow validation test command after the cleanup and resolve failures only within the validation-test scope. Confirm that DTO annotation tests, Spring validator class tests, and custom annotation/custom validator coverage all remain present and school-conform.
acceptance_criteria: The command .\mvnw.cmd -q "-Dtest=*ValidationTests,*ValidatorTests" test is run after the validation test cleanup
All DTO annotation validation tests pass
All Spring validator class tests pass
Custom annotation and custom validator coverage remains present
No controller, security, REST, WebClient, service, or unrelated test cleanup is introduced by this task
Any remaining risk or intentionally skipped optional validation test is documented before closing the task
